dependencies.reason: Provides outline package (outline.Outline, outline.Decl, outline.File), tools.Walk, and tools.CtagsRunner.
Provides find_symbol, symbolTable, SymbolOptions, SymbolMatch, FileNavigationTools(), and dirty-marking hooks in write_file, edit_file, and shell tools.
Provides optional tools.Index integration and candidate lookup acceleration.
Defines tool metadata conventions and prompt guideline assembly.

tasks.title: Define exported Workspace.References types, boundaries, and validation seam
steps: Write unit and property tests TS-05-45, TS-05-47, TS-05-48, TS-05-49, TS-05-50, and TS-05-34 in tools/references_test.go asserting types, signatures, path validation, context cancellation, and MaxResults clamping, confirming they fail.

In tools/references.go (or tools/path.go), define public types ReferenceOptions (Path, IncludeTests, MaxResults), ReferenceSite (Path, Line, Column, Confidence, Enclosing, Source), and ReferenceResult (Target, Sites, Backend, Partial, PackagesChecked, Errors, Truncated).
Implement helper clampMaxResults(int) int normalizing <= 0 to 30 and capping > 100 to 100.

Define the exported method (*Workspace).References(ctx context.Context, target outline.Decl, opts ReferenceOptions) (ReferenceResult, error) validating ctx.Err() and checking opts.Path via Workspace.Resolve and directory stat before delegating to the internal engine.
Verify that escaping paths return ErrPathNotAllowed, non-existent or non-directory paths return error, and pre-cancelled contexts return ctx.Err().

tasks.title: Implement symbol table declaration resolution and disambiguation
steps: Write tests TS-05-8, TS-05-9, TS-05-10, TS-05-11, and TS-05-12 in tools/ref_resolve_test.go covering unqualified and qualified target lookups, filtering by kind and path, find_symbol disambiguation ranking, and fallback on unknown symbols.
Implement helper splitContainerMember(name string) (container, member string) splitting qualified names at the final dot.

Implement resolveSymbolCandidates(st *symbolTable, name, kind, path string) ([]outline.Decl, error) querying the existing symbolTable for matching declarations, supporting container matching and applying kind and path scope filters.

Implement disambiguateSymbol(candidates []outline.Decl, queriedName string) outline.Decl applying exact name match over prefix match, exported over unexported, non-test file (via isTestFile) over test file, shorter path, and ascending start line.
Handle zero matches by returning a zero outline.Decl and signaling a fallback to text reference search with backend 'text'.

tasks.title: Implement Go type resolution engine with synthetic stubs
steps: Write unit and property tests TS-05-13, TS-05-14, TS-05-15, TS-05-16, TS-05-17, and TS-05-18 in tools/ref_gotypes_test.go testing local workspace imports, synthetic external packages, resolved confidence, unrelated method exclusion, demotion of incompletely typed identifiers, and AST comment/position preservation.

Implement workspace-local Go importer in tools/ref_gotypes.go that maps workspace module paths (from go.mod or workspace root) to local package sources using go/parser and token.FileSet with comments preserved.

Ensure external imports (standard library or third-party) return an empty synthetic *types.Package defining zero symbols; configure types.Config with FakeImportC = true and collect type errors in an error slice without aborting.
Type-check workspace Go packages using go/types.Config with types.Info collecting Uses and Defs.

Implement identifier matching: if an AST identifier matches the target declaration name and resolves to target's types.Object, assign confidence 'resolved' (handling receiver methods, interface methods, renamed imports, promoted fields).
Exclude identifiers resolving to unrelated types or distinct packages; demote identifiers whose type originated from a stubbed synthetic import to confidence 'lexical'.

tasks.title: Implement multi-language lexical and text candidate reference scanner
steps: Write unit and property tests TS-05-19, TS-05-20, TS-05-21, TS-05-22, TS-05-23, and TS-05-24 in tools/ref_scanner_test.go covering ignore/hidden traversal, word boundary matching, comment/string discrimination, fallback for undeclared names, and 1-based line/column calculation.
Implement candidate file traversal using tools.Walk, respecting .gitignore, hidden entry exclusion, and checking opts.Index if available.
Implement lexical identifier scanner for outline-supported languages (Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Rust, C, C++, C#, Java, Kotlin, Ruby) matching whole identifier boundaries (\b<name>\b).
Classify matches outside comments and string literals as 'lexical' when target declaration exists; classify matches inside comments/strings or unparseable files as 'text'.
If target declaration was not in symbol table (target == outline.Decl{}), classify all matches across all files as 'text'.
Record 1-based line and 1-based byte column for each match site.

tasks.title: Implement enclosing declaration attribution and snippet sanitization
steps: Write unit and property tests TS-05-25, TS-05-26, TS-05-27, TS-05-28, and TS-05-29 in tools/ref_attribution_test.go covering outline line span inspection, innermost nesting selection, top-level <file> attribution, label formatting, and source snippet sanitization.
Implement findEnclosingDecl(fileOutline *outline.File, line int) outline.Decl to find declarations where StartLine <= line <= EndLine, picking the innermost declaration with the smallest line span.
If line falls outside all declarations in fileOutline, set Enclosing to a zero outline.Decl with Kind: 'file'.
Implement renderEnclosingLabel(decl outline.Decl) string formatting Signature or '<Kind> <Name>' when Kind != 'file', and '<file>' when Kind == 'file'.
Implement sanitizeSnippet(rawLine string) string trimming leading/trailing whitespace, capping byte length at 200 bytes, and replacing ASCII control characters (< 0x20) with spaces.

tasks.title: Implement deterministic reference ranking, bounds, and truncation
steps: Write tests TS-05-30, TS-05-31, TS-05-32, and TS-05-33 in tools/ref_rank_test.go covering deterministic multi-tier sorting, test file exclusion via isTestFile, max_results truncation with CapMarker, and MaxFiles/MaxDuration partial bounds with SymbolPartialMarker.

Implement sortReferenceSites(sites []ReferenceSite) ordering by confidence tier ('resolved' < 'lexical' < 'text'), then non-test before test per isTestFile, then slash-separated path, then 1-based line number, then 1-based column.
Implement test filtering: if includeTests is false, filter out all sites located in test files or directories identified by isTestFile.
Implement bounds checking against SymbolOptions.MaxFiles (50 000) and SymbolOptions.MaxDuration (2 s); if limits trigger, halt gracefully, set Partial = true, and append SymbolPartialMarker().

Apply max_results truncation: clamp between 1 and 100, truncate sites slice if length > max_results, set Truncated = true, and generate advisory truncation marker using CapMarker('references', 'max_results', limit, 100, 'narrow with path or kind').

tasks.title: Implement reference result text rendering and structured payload formatting
steps: Write tests TS-05-35, TS-05-36, TS-05-37, TS-05-38, and TS-05-39 in tools/ref_render_test.go asserting text header format, file grouping and alignment, marker placement, ReferenceResult structured data payload, and zero-match responses.

Implement renderReferencesText(name string, res ReferenceResult) string generating the header 'find_references <name>  (<backend>, <N> references in <M> files; <K> text matches)' (appending '[partial]' when Partial is true).
Format file groups with slash-separated relative path followed by aligned indented lines '  L<line>  <confidence>  <enclosing>  <source_line>'.
Append truncation and partial markers on distinct lines at the conclusion of Text.
Assemble core.ToolResult with OK: true, Text: renderedText, and Data: ReferenceResult; when sites are empty, return OK: true with a zero references header.

tasks.title: Wire reference cache lifecycle, invalidation hooks, and freshness refresh
steps: Write tests TS-05-40, TS-05-41, TS-05-42, TS-05-43, and TS-05-44 in tools/ref_cache_test.go testing lazy cache initialization, write_file/edit_file dirty marking, shell tool whole-table revalidation, dirty package/file re-checking, and .gitignore revalidation.
In tools/symbols.go and tools/tools.go, add referenceCache to fileTools, lazily initialized on first reference query and retained in memory for the lifetime of fileTools.
Wire markTableDirty hooks in write_file and edit_file to mark modified paths dirty in referenceCache upon path lock release.
Wire markTableRevalidateAll hooks in execute, run_command, and powershell to flag referenceCache for whole-table revalidation.
In referenceCache.refresh(ctx), re-parse and re-check dirty Go packages, re-outline dirty non-Go files, purge deleted files from cache, and revalidate candidate files if .gitignore changed.

tasks.title: Implement find_references tool registration, input validation, and execution
steps: Write tests TS-05-1, TS-05-2, TS-05-3, TS-05-4, TS-05-5, TS-05-6, TS-05-7, and TS-05-46 in tools/find_references_test.go validating tool registration, argument schema, input error cases, context cancellation, and parity between Workspace.References and find_references.

Create tools/find_references.go defining findReferencesTool on fileTools with schema (name required, path, kind, include_tests, max_results optional), Builtin: true, ExecutionMode: Parallel, non-shell status, and prompt guideline 'Use find_symbol for where a name is declared, find_references for who uses it, and search_files for text.'.

Implement Execute handling JSON parsing, name validation (reject empty, whitespace, >256 bytes with invalid_arguments), kind validation (against allowed kinds with invalid_arguments), path validation (via Workspace.Resolve with path_not_allowed and directory check with invalid_arguments), and context cancellation (aborted).
Connect find_references execution to reference engine and wire Workspace.References to use the shared reference resolution logic, ensuring identical results.

tasks.title: Register tool in wiring, update system prompt goldens, verify policies, and update documentation
steps: Write and run tests TS-05-51, TS-05-52, TS-05-53, and TS-05-54 checking policy compliance, prompt golden matching, 6 navigation tools in FileNavigationTools(), and documentation updates.
In tools/tools.go, register find_references in All() immediately after find_symbol and append 'find_references' to FileNavigationTools(), expanding it to 6 pinned tool names.
Update prompt/testdata/golden/system_prompt_default.txt and system_prompt_custom.txt (and prompt/golden_test.go, tools/wiring_test.go) to reflect 6 navigation tools and the find_references guideline.
Ensure zero external modules in root go.mod; verify internal/policy tests (TestNoCgoOutsideStdlib, TestCgoProbeIsArmed) pass and cross-compilation builds cleanly.
Update docs/architecture.md, docs/api.md, README.md, and docs/GAPS.md per REQ-10.4 and project steering.
done_when: make check passes and doc updates are verified

tasks.title: Verify end-to-end reference discovery, embedder seam, and cache invalidation
steps: Write and execute TS-05-55, TS-05-56, TS-05-57, TS-05-58, and TS-05-59 in tools/references_smoke_test.go against real workspace fixtures.
Trace 05-PATH-1 through production code: verify Go method caller lookup resolves exact types with 'resolved' confidence and attributes callers to enclosing declarations.
Trace 05-PATH-2 through production code: verify multi-language lexical caller lookup outside comments/strings attributes to enclosing functions with 'lexical' confidence.
Trace 05-PATH-3 through production code: verify fallback text search for an undeclared identifier returns 0 matched declarations with 'text' confidence.
Trace 05-PATH-4 through production code: verify programmatic Workspace.References produces identical structured reference results without model turns.
Trace 05-PATH-5 through production code: verify write_file dirty marking causes reference cache re-parsing and exposes new callers on subsequent reference queries.

For every criterion with a contract (REQ-1.3, REQ-1.4, REQ-1.5, REQ-1.6, REQ-1.7, REQ-2.1, REQ-2.2, REQ-2.3, REQ-2.4, REQ-3.1, REQ-3.2, REQ-3.3, REQ-3.4, REQ-3.5, REQ-4.1, REQ-4.2, REQ-4.3, REQ-4.4, REQ-4.5, REQ-5.1, REQ-5.2, REQ-5.3, REQ-6.2, REQ-6.3, REQ-6.4, REQ-7.3, REQ-7.5, REQ-8.1, REQ-8.2, REQ-8.3, REQ-8.4, REQ-8.5, REQ-9.2, REQ-9.3, REQ-9.4, REQ-9.5), confirm the producer's result is consumed by a caller in production code.
Scan all touched files for TODO, NotImplementedError, panic(\"not implemented\"), and bare nil returns on non-trivial paths and verify none remain.
Run `make check` to ensure all tests pass, formatting is clean, and linters pass cleanly.
done_when: make check passes and all 5 smoke tests pass
